definitions.gloss: to well up, to surge up (emotions)
definitions.explanation: Describes emotions such as sadness, anger, joy, or nostalgia rising uncontrollably from within.
Describes the physical sensation of something rising from the stomach toward the throat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げてきた。
⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げて、⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: Anger surged up and my voice trembled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{友|とも}だち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げてきた。
examples.english: When I saw my friends' faces at the graduation ceremony, emotion welled up inside me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げてきた。
examples.english: Nausea rose up in my throat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げる⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I felt something rising up from my stomach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あたり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げるもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The rocking grew stronger and I felt something rising up in my chest.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げる: tears well up
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げる: anger surges up
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げる: emotions well up
- ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{込|こ}み{上|あ}げる: nausea rises

PATTERN: Often used with 〜てくる to express the sensation arising toward the speaker: {込|こ}み{上|あ}げてくる。

USAGE: A literary and expressive verb frequently used in novels, speeches, and emotional descriptions.
